name: Generativ AI (GenAI)
definition: Builds solutions where AI models generate text, code, images or other content, and knows their strengths, limits and costs.

name: LLM (Large Language Models) / LLM application development
definition: Builds applications on large language models via APIs, cloud model platforms (Azure OpenAI, Bedrock, Vertex AI) and frameworks like LangChain; selects, evaluates and hosts models.

name: Agentisk AI / AI-agenter / agentprotokoll och plattformar
definition: Designs AI agents that plan and run multi-step tasks with tools, using agent protocols (MCP, A2A) and platforms like Copilot Studio, with guardrails and oversight.

name: Multi-agent-system / orkestrering
definition: Designs systems where several AI agents cooperate, including role split, hand-offs, orchestration and failure handling.

name: RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
definition: Builds retrieval-augmented generation: grounding LLM answers in the organisation's own documents and data via search and retrieval.

name: Prompt engineering / context engineering
definition: Writes and tests prompts, instructions and context (system prompts, examples, retrieved data) so models give reliable results.

name: Vektordatabaser / embeddings
definition: Uses embeddings and vector databases (e.g. pgvector, Pinecone, Azure AI Search) for semantic search, matching and RAG.

name: Fine-tuning
definition: Adapts pre-trained models to a domain or task by fine-tuning on own data, incl. data preparation, training and evaluation.

name: Machine Learning / Deep Learning
definition: Builds, trains and evaluates machine learning and deep learning models (e.g. PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn) for prediction, classification, vision or similar.

name: NLP / Conversational AI / chatbotar / röstagenter
definition: Builds solutions that understand or produce natural language and speech: chatbots, real-time voice agents, speech-to-text, classification and text analysis.

name: Intelligent automation / Agentic process automation
definition: Automates business processes by combining RPA, workflow tools and AI agents that read documents, decide and act.

name: MLOps / LLMOps / AI FinOps
definition: Runs ML/LLM models in production: deployment, versioning, monitoring, retraining, CI/CD for models, and inference cost control (AI FinOps).

name: AI-ready data / datastrategi
definition: Prepares data for AI and machine learning: quality, labelling and annotation, feature engineering, training and synthetic data, and vector stores for retrieval.

name: Data lakehouse / Data platform
definition: Designs and builds data platforms (lakehouse, warehouse, e.g. Databricks, Fabric, Snowflake) that AI and analytics run on.

name: Evaluering / guardrails / agent-observability
definition: Tests and assures the quality of AI systems: evaluations of model and agent output, LLM observability, red teaming, bias and fairness testing, and model validation.

name: GitHub Copilot / AI-assisterad utveckling
definition: Uses AI coding agents (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) and spec-driven development effectively, and introduces them in development teams.

name: AIOps
definition: Applies AI in IT operations (AIOps): event correlation, anomaly detection and automated incident handling, incl. platforms such as ServiceNow Now Assist.

name: Regulatory AI
definition: Helps organisations and products comply with AI and digital-product regulation: EU AI Act, CRA, NIS2, Machinery Regulation, Data Act, DPP and related standards.

name: AI governance / Responsible AI / AI-etik
definition: Sets up AI governance: policies, roles, responsible and ethical AI principles, and oversight of AI use.

name: AI- och agentsäkerhet
definition: Identifies and manages AI- and agent-specific security risks: prompt injection, data leakage, tool misuse, agent identity, red teaming, OWASP LLM/agentic Top 10, ISO/IEC 42001.

name: AI-strategi / AI-roadmap / AI-mognad
definition: Develops AI strategy and roadmap from business goals, and assesses an organisation's AI maturity.

name: AI-transformation / förändringsledning / AI-adoption
definition: Leads AI transformation: finds and prioritises AI use cases and ROI, then drives change, training and adoption, incl. Microsoft 365 Copilot rollout.

name: Decision models / beslutsmodeller
definition: Uses decision models that choose among given options and return a calibrated probability, to automate yes/no, classification and scoring decisions with confidence thresholds.

name: Computer vision / visuell inspektion / VLM
definition: Builds computer vision solutions for inspection, detection and measurement with classic CV, deep learning and vision language models, from camera to deployed model.

name: Edge AI / on-device inference
definition: Runs AI models on devices and industrial edge hardware (Jetson, MCUs, IPCs): model compression, quantization, real-time inference and power/latency trade-offs.

name: AI-driven Prediktivt underhåll / anomalidetektion
definition: Builds predictive maintenance and anomaly detection on sensor and time-series data: condition monitoring, forecasting, alerting and integration with maintenance processes.

name: Digitala tvillingar / simulering / syntetisk data
definition: Builds digital twins and simulations of products, lines or facilities, connects them to live data, and uses them to test, train and generate synthetic data for AI.

name: Robotik och autonoma system
definition: Develops robots and autonomous systems: perception, sensor fusion, navigation, control and, increasingly, AI policies trained in simulation (physical AI), with ROS or vendor platforms.

name: AI på OT-data (MES/SCADA/UNS, industriella copiloter)
definition: Applies AI to operational data from MES, SCADA, historians and a unified namespace, incl. industrial copilots and agents inside OT security and safety constraints.

name: Suverän AI / självhostade och öppna modeller
definition: Runs AI on own or EU-hosted infrastructure for data residency, air-gapped or regulated use: selects and self-hosts open-weight models, serving, access control and fine-tuning.
